_comment: prompt_for/promptFor must return the SAME string in every SDK. Python's json.dumps defaults to ', '/': ' and JS's JSON.stringify emits neither, so the two languages built different prompts from the same view. Compact separators everywhere; these vectors pin it. Nothing about the prompt is scored — the point is that a paired cross-SDK comparison of one scaffold is comparing ONE prompt. ensure_ascii=False too: json.dumps escapes non-ASCII to \uXXXX and JSON.stringify does not, which diverged on any non-English handle or chat line.
